summary: Advanced Float is a Tokyo company that plans to own and operate offshore floating nuclear power plants. Its reference design puts an Advanced Boiling Water Reactor (ABWR) of about 1,350 MWe on a moored steel floating platform. The first plant is to be licensed in the United States, with no site selected.
oneLiner: A Tokyo company planning to own and operate offshore floating nuclear power plants
thesis: A utility-scale nuclear plant meant to be fabricated in a shipyard rather than built on land, spanning energy and manufacturing. It has an NRC pre-application docket, and the founder was Chief Nuclear Officer of TEPCO from 2014 to 2017.
stage: Established 9 February 2024. Pre-seed of 100 million yen in total from Mirai Sozo Investments' Fund II, announced 20 June 2025. The company site says a seed round closed in April 2026, with no amount or investor named. On 14 September 2026 it submitted a Regulatory Engagement Plan to the NRC, a planning document, not an application. It lists a Standard Design Approval application in 2027 as a planning assumption.

team.name: Takafumi Anegawa
team.background: Founder and CEO. Per the company site, Chief Nuclear Officer of TEPCO from 2014 to 2017 and led the COCN offshore nuclear project from 2020 to 2022.

team.name: Ryohei Takahashi
team.background: Outside director and lead investor per the company site, which calls him a former deep-tech founder and CEO and co-general partner at an unnamed venture capital firm.

team.name: John Parsons Wheeler
team.background: Head of Corporate Development. The company site describes him as an energy-infrastructure executive and serial cleantech founder, with no employers named.

team.name: Kevin Hickey Jr., P.E.
team.background: Regulatory and maritime nuclear engineering. The company site describes him as a former U.S. Navy nuclear submarine operator with ASME pressure-vessel design and licensing support experience.

questions: Which reactor vendor will supply the ABWR nuclear island, and is anything signed? The Regulatory Engagement Plan refers only to a 'reactor-technology provider'.
How large was the April 2026 seed, who invested, and what does it fund through the planned 2027 Standard Design Approval application? What is the Series A for?
The NRC plan names the company 'or an affiliated U.S. entity' as licence applicant and owner-operator. Which is it, and is any U.S. utility or offtaker engaged?
Nikkei xTECH reported design work with Mitsui Ocean Development (MODEC) and volume production in 2032. Which shipyard and marine engineering contracts exist, and what is the schedule now?
risks: The only disclosed funding amount is 100 million yen of pre-seed money, against a reference plant of about 1,350 MWe. No source opened describes how the plant would be financed.
No site, reactor vendor, shipyard, utility or offtaker is named on the company site or in the NRC filing.
The licensing path is first of a kind. The filing so far is a planning document, not an application, and says the design approval review may extend beyond eighteen months.
unverified: The company site says a seed round closed in April 2026. No public announcement of it was found, and no primary source gives the amount or valuation.
Design work with Mitsui Ocean Development (MODEC) is reported by Nikkei xTECH (10 December 2025) but not confirmed on the company site or in the NRC filing.
Mirai Sozo Investments lists a Ryohei Takahashi as managing partner. No page opened states he is the Advanced Float outside director, whose firm the company site leaves unnamed.
